model_form: Sparse symbolic-regression closure: T1 plus a T2 term with exponential strain dependence plus a T3 term linear in the strain invariant.
reference: M. Schmelzer, R. P. Dwight, P. Cinnella (2020), "Discovery of algebraic Reynolds-stress models using sparse symbolic regression", Flow Turbul. Combust. 104, 579-603. doi:10.1007/s10494-019-00089-x
